## Purpose and Scopesvg image

The `updater` command applies patch files to context files, enabling incremental updates without recreating entire context files from scratch. This command is the companion to patch generation commands: it consumes the patch files produced by `updatecontext` [see 5.3.1](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.1-updatecontext) or `smartupdate` [see 5.3.3](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.3-smartupdate) and applies their changes to a target context file.

Two command variants exist:

- **`updater`**: Applies patches to Markdown context files
- **`updaterhtml`**: Applies patches to HTML context files

Both commands support cross-format patching (e.g., applying a Markdown patch to an HTML context file), making them flexible for diverse workflows.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md28-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L28-L29) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L33-L33) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py28](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L28-L28) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L36-L36) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py44](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L44-L44) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py52](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L52-L52)

## Command Variants Comparisonsvg image

| Feature | `updater` | `updaterhtml` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Target Format** | Markdown (`.md`) context files | HTML (`.html`) context files |
| **Patch Format Accepted** | `.md` or `.html` patches | `.md` or `.html` patches |
| **Entry Point** | `updater:main` | `updater_html:main` |
| **Module** | `updater.py` | `updater_html.py` |
| **Output** | Modified Markdown context file | Modified HTML context file |
| **Use Case** | Development/working format updates | Presentation/distribution format updates |

## Command Syntaxsvg image

### Basic Usage Patternssvg image

### Parameter Descriptionssvg image

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `patch_file` | Path | Yes | Path to patch file (`.md` or `.html` format) |
| `target_context` | Path | Yes | Path to existing context file to be updated |
| `output_context` | Path | No | Path for updated context file (defaults to overwriting target) |

### Output Behaviorsvg image

- **If `output_context` is specified**: Writes updated context to new file, preserving original
- **If `output_context` is omitted**: Overwrites `target_context` with updated version (destructive)

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md28](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L28-L28) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L33-L33)

## Patch Application Processsvg image

### High-Level Algorithmsvg image

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L176) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py70-108](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L70-L108) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py111-129](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L111-L129) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py180-216](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L180-L216)

### Step-by-Step Executionsvg image

#### 1. Patch Parsingsvg image

The `parse_patch_file()` function [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-137](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L137) automatically detects patch format:

**For Markdown patches** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py139-161](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L139-L161):

- Scans for headers matching `^--- DIFF FOR: (.*) ---$` pattern
- Extracts unified diff content between code fences
- Converts diff text to `patch` library objects via `patch.fromstring()`

**For HTML patches** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py163-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L163-L176):

- Uses BeautifulSoup to find `<div class='diff-container'>` elements
- Extracts `data-path` attribute for file identification
- Parses `<pre>` tag contents as diff text

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L176)

#### 2. Context File Parsingsvg image

**For Markdown targets** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py70-108](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L70-L108):

- `parse_md_constructor()` extracts files from context
- Returns dictionary: `{filepath: content_string or None}`
- Handles binary file markers: `SKIPPED (BINARY)`

**For HTML targets** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py111-129](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L111-L129):

- `parse_html_constructor()` uses BeautifulSoup
- Extracts from `<div class='file-container'>` and `<div class='skipped-container'>`
- Reads `data-path` attributes and code block contents

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py70-129](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L70-L129)

#### 3. Patch Applicationsvg image

The `patch` library [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py11](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L11-L11) performs actual diff application:

The patch library provides:

- **`patch.fromstring()`**: Parses unified diff format into patch objects
- **Patch application**: Applies line-level changes to file content
- **Conflict detection**: Identifies when patches cannot be cleanly applied

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py11](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L11-L11) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py150](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L150-L150) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py155](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L155-L155) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py159](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L159-L159) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py175](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L175-L175)

#### 4. Context Reconstructionsvg image

**For Markdown output**:

- Iterates through updated `files_dict`
- Writes headers: `--- FILE: <path> ---`
- Wraps content in language-tagged code fences
- Marks binary files: `--- SKIPPED (BINARY): <path> ---`

**For HTML output** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py180-216](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L180-L216):

- Calls `rebuild_html_constructor()`
- Generates styled HTML with Pygments syntax highlighting
- Embeds CSS from `HtmlFormatter().get_style_defs()`
- Creates `<div class='file-container'>` for each file

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py180-216](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L180-L216)

Markdown patches use this format [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py139-161](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L139-L161):

The parser:

1. Matches header pattern: `^--- DIFF FOR: (.*) ---$` [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py144](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L144-L144)

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py139-161](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L139-L161)

### HTML Patch Structuresvg image

HTML patches use structured containers [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py163-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L163-L176):

The parser:

1. Finds all `div.diff-container` elements [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py171](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L171-L171)
2. Extracts `data-path` attribute [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py172](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L172-L172)
3. Reads `<pre>` tag text content [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py173](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L173-L173)
4. Converts to patch object [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py175](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L175-L175)

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py163-176](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L163-L176)

### Error Handlingsvg image

Common error scenarios:

| Error Condition | Detection | Typical Cause |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Patch file not found | `FileNotFoundError` in parser | Invalid path argument |
| Context file not found | `FileNotFoundError` in parser | Invalid target argument |
| Patch application failure | `patch` library exception | File content has changed |
| Invalid patch format | Parser returns `None` | Corrupted or malformed patch |
| Binary file patching | Patch applied to `None` content | Attempting to patch binary files |

The parsers return `None` on `FileNotFoundError` [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py107](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L107-L107) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py160](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L160-L160) signaling missing files to the caller.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py107](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L107-L107) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py160](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L160-L160) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py169](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L169-L169)

## Integration with Version Controlsvg image

### Workflow Patternsvg image

**Use cases**:

- **Incremental updates**: Share only changes, not full contexts
- **Code review**: Patches show exactly what changed
- **Rollback**: Generate reverse patches for undo operations
- **Distribution**: Smaller patch files vs. full context files

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md27-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L27-L29)

---

## Performance Considerationssvg image

### Patch Size vs. Full Rebuildsvg image

| Scenario | Patch File Size | Full Context Size | Updater Efficiency |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single file change | ~1 KB | ~100 KB | 100x smaller transfer |
| Multiple file edits | ~5 KB | ~100 KB | 20x smaller transfer |
| Large refactor | ~50 KB | ~100 KB | 2x smaller transfer |

### Optimization Strategiessvg image

1. **Use `smartupdate` for generation** [see 5.3.3](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.3-smartupdate): rsync-based algorithm produces smaller patches
2. **Batch updates**: Apply multiple patches sequentially rather than regenerating contexts
3. **Cross-format application**: Convert between MD/HTML without full reconstruction

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L29-L29)

---
